agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Breaks high-level goals into concrete, ordered tasks.
agents.cronTask: Review the backlog and propose the next action.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Gathers context and references for the current task.
agents.cronTask: Refresh source material for open questions.

agents.name: Executor
agents.role: Carries out approved tasks and reports results.

agents.name: Oil Change Updater
agents.role: Takes over GrokBot's 6am eFleets due-list: CHANGE OIL AFTER 5K on the Automations copy.
agents.cronTask: Build the CHANGE OIL AFTER 5K overdue list from the eFleets All Cars sorted export.

agents.name: Oil Change Implementer
agents.role: Rebuilds the overdue list from the working Automations sheet export. Never edits the original PDI template.
agents.cronTask: Recompute overdue / suspect / backward from the working sheet export.

agents.name: Oil Change Reviewer
agents.role: Blocks fake green: overdue must not include suspect jumps or backward odometers.
agents.cronTask: Review the latest oil due-list and refuse polluted overdue rows.
